# HBA modification of HBB-associated phenotypes

This analysis is restricted to historical individuals with an interpretable
primary HBB genotype, a canonical HBA state and temporally meaningful phenotype
measurements. Eligible denominators for Hb, MCV, MCH, HbA2 and HbF must be reported
separately.

A primary explanatory model is

$$
Y = \beta_0 + \beta_{HBA} + \beta_{HBB} +
    \beta_{HBA\times HBB} + \gamma^T X + u_{family/person} + \epsilon,
$$

where $X$ contains available age, sex, referral indication, ancestry proxy, iron
status, transfusion/treatment context and measurement timing. Repeated measurements
or related individuals require clustered or mixed-effects inference.

Variant-effect predictors are secondary, class-specific evidence: splice models
for splice variants, regulatory models for promoter variants and protein/structure
models for coding missense variants. Deletions, gains and hybrid genes require an
explicit structural representation rather than a generic protein score.
